BOSS TIME: Follower
HP: 982
WEAKNESS: None

subject: Follower
text: In the fight against Follower, Aguro and the Hero should use Power Gourds on turn one while Lufia casts Drain, Awaken to cure Drowsy sleep, and Stronger to heal.

evidence.quote: STRATEGY: Aguro and the Hero should each use a Power Gourd in the first round, while Lufia casts Drain.  The only real danger is if he manages to put you to sleep with Drowsy, although Lufia has the Awaken spell to counter it.  Eventually, you may need to have Lufia heal with Stronger, but this is a pretty easy boss fight.
